dependence_guardrail.reason: Repeated persons and substantially overlapping target windows violate the intended independent-sample interpretation.

unique_person_first_selection_sensitivit.repeat_rule: The 38 repeat-selected persons are counted once using their 2010 first-selection T+10 snapshot.
unique_person_first_selection_sensitivit.calendar_guardrail: This is person-specific T+10 from first selection, not a common-calendar-year cross-section.

frozen_interpretation: The two waves are similarly saturated for broad established-role occupancy at T+10.
The 2011 wave has higher descriptive Major-role occupancy than the 2010 wave.
Apex occupancy remains sparse and similar in magnitude.
The Major difference is descriptive and must not be labeled causal or as an independent two-sample effect.
Placement-level and deduplicated person-level summaries should be reported together for cross-wave work.
